name: atlas-portfolio-tracker
description: Personal investment portfolio manager: append-only ledger, FIFO lots, Spanish tax preparation

scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build -w @atlas/web && npm run build -w @atlas/api && npm run build -w @atlas/jobs
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/dist-test packages/*/coverage apps/*/dist apps/*/dist-test apps/*/dist-lambda tests/dist infra/test/dist coverage node_modules/.vite
scripts.test:all: bash -c 'npm run test & main=$!; npm run test:infra; infra=$?; wait $main; [ $? -eq 0 ] && [ $infra -eq 0 ]'
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:domain && npm run test:coverage:access && npm run test:coverage:api-access && npm run test:others
scripts.test:others: vitest run --project adapters --project cli --project jobs --project web --project repo
